questions.question: What's the actual impact of fees and slippage on retail-size paper-traded crypto strategies?
questions.summary: ~$1/round-trip on $200 positions (0.25% taker both legs). Gross +$1,085 became net -$782 on the 3-month backtest — the delta is the answer. Fees erase thin edges.

questions.question: Which parameter ranges of Bollinger and MA-crossover are robust to regime shifts, and which are overfit?
questions.summary: None are robust: all 12 variants with n>100 negative over 6 months net of costs. Per-regime conditioning untested (rung 3).

questions.question: (Emergent) Do constraints or strategies determine outcomes at this scale?
questions.summary: Constraints dominate: 99.6% of candidate signals died on cooldown/exposure/concurrency. Candidate fitness = edge per constraint slot, not signal frequency.

questions.question: Does sentiment data (Fear & Greed) improve technical strategies, or is it noise?
questions.summary: Layer 2 (context) never went live; deferred past Phase 1b per one-factor-at-a-time.

questions.question: Does the walk-forward tuner produce variants that hold up out-of-sample?
questions.summary: tune.py never built; compare.py (the scoring instrument) now exists. Blocked on the candidate roster accumulating live trades.

learnings.claim: GitHub Actions free-tier */5 cron on a small/inactive public repo delivers only ~3-5% of scheduled invocations (~60min actual cadence vs 5min), making the 95% uptime gate unclearable on that platform.
learnings.evidence: 2026-05-18 GH cron cadence entry; 2026-05-23 migration entry (69/1712 = 4.0% invocation rate over six days)

learnings.claim: Migrating the cron to a Hetzner CX22 VPS clears the 95% uptime architectural gate as written.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 47-day-gap entry: 11,490+ fetch commits with zero gaps, runs 84->11,574 all status=ok, gate 1 mechanically satisfied

learnings.claim: Both base textbook strategies (Bollinger, MA-crossover) are net-negative over a real 6-month window; every variant with n>100 loses money.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 retire entry: 12 variants, net -$1,719.44 (-0.13%), worst is bollinger_default n=539 -$636.75, only positives are n=3/n=13 noise

learnings.claim: The fee floor (~0.6% round-trip cost) exceeds the gross edge of short-horizon strategies; gross-positive strategies are still net-negative after fees.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-16 gauntlet entry: all five LLM candidates lost net of fees; weekend_illiquidity_momentum gross-positive (Sharpe 1.51) but fee-negative

learnings.claim: Maker (post-only limit) fills beat taker fills mechanically for drawdown-buying strategies, saving ~$0.21-0.24/trade with near-zero fill loss because price falls into the resting limit.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-17 first net-positive cell entry: maker beat taker in 12/12 matched pairs, mean +$0.14/slot, fill loss 0-4 trades per ~150

learnings.claim: The gauntlet's detection power is near zero for real edges below ~+0.6% net; reliable detection starts ~+0.6% net (+1.2% over null), and a +0.17%-net edge passes only 32% at n=100.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 power calibration entry; reports/power-calibration-2026-07-18.json (bootstrap n=7,068, mean -0.633%/trade)
learnings.next_check: when costs, constraints, or the kill bar change

learnings.claim: The +0.3% kill bar has a 21% false-positive rate at n=7, vindicating the n<30 quarantine rule quantitatively.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 power calibration entry finding 1

learnings.claim: Near-zero elapsed calendar time contributed to learning: nearly everything the project learned was produced in ~48 hours (2026-07-16/17); eleven weeks of calendar bought one day of live trade-days.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-17 correction entry (the sequence was valuable; the duration was not); live clock started 2026-07-16

learnings.claim: The blind-elicitation exercise with fresh unanchored context produced more validated learning in one day than any week of inside work (ceiling study, power calibration, netting, slow-band prior, cost decomposition all trace to it).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-18 outside-eyes-institutionalized entry

learnings.claim: Short-horizon crypto continuation (<=24h, taker) has gross edge below the cost floor at every horizon <=12h and is archived.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 K1 adjudication entry (ceiling-study evidence)

learnings.claim: Crypto momentum in 2024-26 is negative/reverting (0/9 directional cells, -12.4%); equity time-series momentum also lost to drift in-window (0/9 long-or-flat cells).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 equity sky check sober-reading entry; E1 result

learnings.claim: Survivorship correction weakens the cross-sectional equity momentum spread: pooled t collapses from ~1.9 to +1.02 (n=43) and the 2020-21 window flips sign to -2.57%/mo.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 corrected equity re-score entry; report equity-sky-pit-2026-07-20.json

learnings.claim: The equity cross-sectional 12-1 momentum pipeline is validated: it detects momentum with the correct sign and the textbook Daniel-Moskowitz momentum-crash signature (-17.3%/yr in 2020-21 rebound, +28.9%/yr in 2024-26).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 E2 round zero pipeline-validated entry; round zero replication

learnings.claim: The round-zero +14.9%/yr magnitude is not a deployable edge: it is far above the pre-registered 2-4%/yr band, only marginally significant (t=1.57, n=59), and ran on a modified pass (n=59 months vs the registered 20+ years) due to Alpaca history reaching only ~2021.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 E2 round zero entry and referee amendments

learnings.claim: The 59-month equity test window is typical, not a freak regime: French UMD 2021-26 (+0.47%/mo) sits within the 1927-present distribution (+0.62%/mo, z=-0.26).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 UMD cross-check entry; report umd-crosscheck-2026-07-20.json

learnings.claim: The measured equity object is momentum: tilt-vs-UMD correlation is +0.49 in high-|UMD| storm months vs +0.09 in calm months (the 'same beast in storms' pattern), even though full-sample correlation is only +0.26.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-20 identity test entry; report umd-identity-2026-07-20.json (storm n=11, SE~0.27)

learnings.claim: No single equity price/volume factor clears the best-of-4 hurdle (~1.7t) on the liquid top-500 universe; momentum is the only positive at +1.24%/mo t=1.57, sub-threshold.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 E2 round one entry; reports/equity-gauntlet-2026-07-23.json (n=59mo)
learnings.next_check: before low-vol verdict stands (scored by wrong metric, re-score needed)

learnings.claim: The equity price-factor structure (single and combined, weekly/monthly/quarterly, on liquid large-caps) is null / efficient after costs; multi-factor composites reduce excess and IR vs momentum alone.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 equity price-factor NULL entry (combination stage plus round one plus round 1b)

learnings.claim: Crypto shock-fade shows a genuine lead: 72h pure-hold n=18 net +3.68%/tr t=2.34, positive in all three sub-regimes and beating the volume-less placebo by +2.4%/tr, but it is horizon-unstable (120h dead) and rides the 2024-25 reversion regime.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 D1 shock-fade entry

learnings.claim: The exit-shape must match the thesis: applying asymmetric continuation exits (tp/sl) to a reversion thesis produces a false kill; a matched pure multi-day hold revives shock-fade.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 D1 shock-fade entry (first tp8/sl5 cut killed it; matched yardstick revived it); same low-vol-wrong-yardstick error

learnings.claim: The VRP harvester's premium is genuinely thin at the real 20% richness bar: SPY/QQQ/IWM credit is only 4-15% of width, so the machine correctly skips all three indices.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 VRP first live paper run entry; scripts/vrp_harvester.py

learnings.claim: The LLM stand-aside rule is too blunt to be useful initially: it defaults to generic caution because every 5-week window has a CPI/FOMC and guesses macro dates it cannot know, so it would stand aside almost always.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 VRP built + first live paper run entry (honest finding)

learnings.claim: The VRP machine is fully validated end-to-end: real macro calendar + refined stand-aside correctly decides WRITE at forced-rich, and Alpaca paper accepted a multi-leg SPY 705/700p spread (status 200).
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 VRP fully validated entry

learnings.claim: Defined-risk VRP is a breadth game, not a size game: functional floor ~$25k, sweet spot $50-100k, expected total-book return only ~5-8%/yr of which ~half is T-bill yield on idle cash and the VRP edge adds only ~2-4 points with a fat negative left tail.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-24 VRP fully validated end-to-end entry (corrected return expectation; earlier $5-15k/yr figure too rosy)

learnings.claim: No real credential was ever committed to the repo; the .env exposure surface was the Claude Code session transcript, not the repository.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-16 post-incident .env entry (full git-history search 2026-07-16 confirmed only placeholders in .env.template, .env never tracked)

learnings.claim: The shared position ceiling means adding backtest variants does not add exposure; running all 12 variants in parallel on Day 1 was safe because variants compete for the same $1,000 cap.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-02 front-loaded 12 variants entry (99.6% candidate signals rejected, exposure never breached)

learnings.claim: Directional price-prediction / mispricing-hunting is exhausted in both crypto and equity markets (~40 falsifications); the project never demonstrated the capability of finding edge this way.
learnings.evidence: 2026-07-23 next-chapter-set entry (efficiency verdict, ~40 falsifications both markets); 2026-07-23 course-correction entries

hypotheses.commitment: By end of the first calendar week of cron operation, the runs table should contain ~2,016 rows with status='ok' (90%+ success rate); if below 90%, investigate before Week 2 strategy-roster review begins.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-05-17 — Curriculum anchor is first cron run
hypotheses.resolution: Falsified by observed GH Actions throttling: 69/1712 = 4.0% invocation rate over six days (2026-05-18 and 2026-05-23 entries). Original hypothesis amended on 2026-05-23 to separate invocation rate (VPS-controlled) from code success rate.

hypotheses.commitment: By end of Week 2, the operator commits a decision-log entry naming one of (a/b/c) for scheduler scope; if no decision is committed by end of Week 2, the Week 3 build doesn't begin until it's made.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-05-18 — GH cron cadence does not match assumed 5-min
hypotheses.resolution: Effectively resolved by the 2026-05-23 migration to Hetzner VPS (moved everything to one real scheduler), though the intervening 47-day operator gap meant the formal Week-2 process was disrupted.

hypotheses.commitment: By end of Week 2, Claude-mediated synthesis produces either (a) a defensible justification for keeping Bollinger and MA-crossover naming which modern-filter criteria they pass/fail, or (b) a defensible alternative roster; if neither in two weeks, the LLM-as-epistemological-backbone thesis is weaker than expected and Week 3 starts a postmortem on the reframe.
hypotheses.resolution: Resolved 2026-07-02: the 6-month replay retired both base strategies on evidence and replaced them with LLM-surfaced candidates climbing the adaptation ladder.

hypotheses.commitment: The reframe's Phase 2 gates and exit conditions remain pre-committed and may not be revised on the strength of in-Phase-1 enthusiasm (adaptive clause carve-out).

The residual (24h+maker fills and reversion-shaped 2-8 week specs) resolves by 2026-08-31 gated on the real-money RTC measurement; if the RTC cannot run by 2026-08-15, the residual resolves on the assumed 0.6% cost figure treated as adverse.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-07-20 — K1 adjudication: short-horizon crypto archived, residual on a dated clock

hypotheses.commitment: Program-level kill criterion v2: by 2026-08-31 and every 6 months thereafter, run the ceiling study per a locked analysis plan; futility trigger fires if the one-sided 90% upper-CB of net_edge is below zero at every h in H.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-07-19 — Operator ratification: all pending drafts approved (kill criterion v2)

hypotheses.commitment: If the corrected re-score flips the cross-sectional sign or collapses pooled t toward zero, the E2 rationale formally reverts to breadth-and-throughput-only, and round zero proceeds anyway.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-07-20 — The equity sky check, sober reading (B2 corrected-archive pre-commitment)
hypotheses.resolution: Resolved 2026-07-20 (corrected re-score entry): pooled t collapsed to +1.02 and 2020-21 flipped sign, so E2 rationale reverted to breadth-and-throughput-only and round zero proceeded regardless. No improvised decision required.

hypotheses.commitment: E2 round zero must first VALIDATE the pipeline by detecting 12-1 momentum inside or above the pre-registered 2-4%/yr long-only-over-benchmark band with correct sign at the significance 20+ years of monthly data affords; a noisy positive is NOT detection and a failure is a build bug not a market verdict.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-07-20 — E2 OPENED: equity cross-sectional program (round-zero pre-registration)
hypotheses.resolution: Resolved 2026-07-20 (E2 round zero entry): pipeline validated by the crash signature with correct sign, but on a MODIFIED pass (n=59 months, not the registered 20+ years, due to data availability); magnitude +14.9%/yr distrusted.

hypotheses.commitment: gate_family / rejection_streak_gated_ignition (r002) gets an out-of-sample re-test on the NEXT 180d window before any gate-family idea is judged again; that result decides whether the gate fits the current regime or best-of-round is what recency overfit looks like.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-07-17 — Seam closed for real; first fully autonomous cycle ran (watchlist decision)

hypotheses.commitment: If null_baseline shows a positive edge over a real sample, something is wrong with the simulator, fee model, or market data — investigate before believing any candidate's results.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-07-16 — Null variant live: the placebo arm is the first live strategy

hypotheses.commitment: The 2026 holdout window is never used for selection; it answers one question per candidate and is reserved for a candidate whose selection-window edge is large enough that generalization is a real question.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-07-17 — First net-positive cell; cost lever validated; holdout NOT burned

hypotheses.commitment: Phase 2 entry requires all three gates: >=95% uptime over prior 4 weeks, >=1 A/B-validated promotion (p<0.05, 100+ trades), and positive 30-day P&L OR explicit written override; the first two are non-negotiable.
hypotheses.source_entry: 2026-04-26 — Three explicit gates for Phase 2 entry

hypotheses.commitment: Real money returns to paper or archives if any of: drawdown below $700 (-30%), real diverges from paper by >50% over any 2-week window, or 8 weeks elapse regardless of P&L (mandatory review week).
If two consecutive foundry rounds produce only registry-shaped deaths with no novel mechanism, the foundry prompt is the problem and that gets its own entry.
